extends: vendor-directory.v1.json at version 1.1.0. All v1 read, write, trust, filtering and pagination guarantees remain unchanged.

query.contract: vendor-directory.v2 explicitly negotiates people on vendor list rows and vendor detail. vendor-directory.v1 retains its exact existing shape without people. An absent selector retains the legacy shape. Unknown selectors are refused.

people.shape: Array of {company,contact,office,research}, ordered by contact UUID. Nested under each vendor in list and detail. Empty when no exact live named person is recorded. Does not multiply vendor totals or alter vendor pagination.
people.identity: Uses v_vendor_assignment_context. Person vendors select themselves. Organization vendors select only live named people whose org_id is that organization. Deleted and merged people are excluded. Missing email, phone or cell never excludes a person.
people.company: Exact live organization {id,name} or null. Company identity never verifies a person office.
people.contact: Exact live person {id,name,email,phone,cell}. Unknown contact channels remain null.
people.office: Verified {street_address,city,state,finding_id,source,observed_at,expires_on} or null. Uses the same latest-finding verification as read-vendor-meetings. Requires source_backed, found true, office location, nonblank string street_address/city/state, nonblank source, nonfuture observation and unexpired finding. Internal and proposed-correction findings cannot verify an office.
people.research: {status,finding_id,observed_at,expires_on} for the newest address finding on the exact person. Status is not_researched, needs_review or office_verified. Describes recorded finding progress only, never a queued or running enrichment job. A newer unusable finding prevents revival of an older verified office.
people.source: Existing party and record_flag facts through v_vendor_assignment_context and v_record_flag_subject. Write findings with the existing record-finding owner verb. No new write path or invented business data.
people.scope: Office location is distinct from recorded vendor territory. Office verification does not assert meeting readiness, contact permission, approved client need, market membership or introduction state.
